context: A greenfield module with three phases (CSV generation, background job, status polling). The criteria check whether the answer advises starting coarse, co-locating coupled code, reaching for abstractions over file splits, and using a line threshold as the split trigger.

checklist.name: Start coarser, don't pre-split
checklist.description: Advises starting coarser / not pre-splitting the three phases into many files up front

checklist.name: Co-locate coupled job lifecycle
checklist.description: Recommends co-locating the tightly coupled job lifecycle and polling

checklist.name: Abstraction over bare file split
checklist.description: Recommends reaching for an abstraction (well-named function/module with a clear interface) rather than splitting files for their own sake

checklist.name: ~300-line split trigger
checklist.description: Mentions a ~300-line threshold (or 'a few hundred lines') as the trigger to split
